        cleaned = re.sub(r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]", "", cleaned)
        cleaned = cleaned.strip()

        if cleaned == "":
            cell.value = None
        else:
            try:
                cell.value = excel_round_to_int(cleaned)
            except Exception:
